target_disease: Cerebral Arteriopathy, Autosomal Recessive, with Subcortical Infarcts and Leukoencephalopathy 1
overlapping_phenotypes: Lacunar infarcts, microbleeds, leukoencephalopathy, cognitive decline
discriminating_phenotype: Infantile onset with periatrial white matter volume loss and preserved temporal poles
discriminating_logic: Dominant CADASIL presents at ages 30–50 with >88% temporal pole WMH, whereas biallelic LoF presents in early childhood (9–14 months) with periatrial white matter loss and preserved temporal poles.
